 Another Snow Teaser and Impressive Rain Storm 
 Add to Favorites Add Alert 
 Summary
 We will continue to see scattered showers today as the storm gradually moves east and out of the area. Chances for showers could continue into Sunday, but otherwise we are entering a break. A weak storm will brush Utah midweek, bringing chances for light showers. A chance for another stronger storm next weekend.
